Posting here for any Meta employees who may be reading. This flaw has been around for at least a few days and has been used to hijack over 100 high-value Instagram accounts. items.title: BEYOND Expo 2026现场：联汇科技Om AI首发的OttoBox视频创作助理，把视频粗剪从8小时拉进30分钟
items.raw_excerpt: 在BEYOND Expo 2026（BEYOND国际科技创新博览会）上，杭州联汇科技股份有限公司（以下简称联汇科技，Om AI）正式发布新一代 AI 原生产品——OttoBox 视频创作助理。 这款被定义为 AI时代“新一代内容创作搭档” 的重磅新品，以联汇科技自研端侧多模态大模型OmModel为大脑，通过AI Drive、AI Finder、AI Agent三位一体的功能架构，重塑AI内容管理与创作的新模式、新习惯。同时，推出AI Studio（旗舰工作站）、Otto Claw（移动助手）、OttoCloud（弹性云端）三大用户模式，覆盖从个人创作者到大型机构的全部场景，为打造AI PC、AI手机与端云协同的多元工具生态奠定基石。 三位一体架构重塑内容创作新习惯 传统视频创作中，素材整理、检索、粗剪占据了创作者80%以上的时间。OttoBox通过三层递进式能力，将这一流程压缩至分钟级。 AI Drive 认知引擎，入库即理解。 全格式素材一键导入，本地毫秒级完成 OCR、ASR、镜头切分与向量化标签。数据不出域，从根源解决企业核心资产的安全与隐私顾虑。 AI Finder检索引擎，检索即定位。 作为全球首个视频搜索引擎，用户只需输入一句话，系统毫秒级定位目标片段。平均30分钟的检索耗时缩短至10秒，效率提升180倍，“像回忆一样搜索”。 AI Agent执行引擎，指令即成片。 内置多个AI Agent智能体，一句话生成粗剪、自动提取高光、撰写脚本与旁白。原本8-10小时的粗剪工作压缩至30分钟，并可一键导出至剪映等专业工具，实现零门槛高效出片，生产力跃迁。 对于创作者而言，AI Drive+AI Finder+AI Agent三位一体的核心架构意味着理解成本、检索成本、创作成本的骤降，能够让创作者在工作中真正回归创意本身。

excerpt_i18n.en: At BEYOND Expo 2026, Hangzhou Lianhui Technology Co., Ltd. (referred to as Lianhui Technology, Om AI) officially launched its next-generation AI-native product—OttoBox Video Creation Assistant. This major new product, defined as the "new-generation content creation partner" in the AI era, is powered by OmModel, Lianhui Technology's self-developed on-device multimodal large model. Through a tripartite functional architecture of AI Drive, AI Finder, and AI Agent, it reshapes new models and habits for AI-driven content management and creation. Additionally, three user modes—AI Studio (flagship workstation), Otto Claw (mobile assistant), and OttoCloud (elastic cloud)—are introduced, covering all scenarios from individual creators to large organizations, laying the foundation for a diverse tool ecosystem encompassing AI PCs, AI phones, and end-cloud collaboration. The tripartite architecture reshapes new habits in content creation. In traditional video creation, material organization, retrieval, and rough editing consume over 80% of creators' time. OttoBox compresses this process to the minute level through three progressive capabilities. AI Drive cognitive engine: understanding upon import. One-click import of all formats, with local millisecond-level completion of OCR, ASR, shot segmentation, and vectorized tagging. Data remains within the domain, fundamentally addressing enterprise core asset security.
excerpt_i18n.es: En BEYOND Expo 2026 (Exposición Internacional de Innovación Tecnológica BEYOND), Hangzhou Lianhui Technology Co., Ltd. (en adelante, Lianhui Technology, Om AI) lanzó oficialmente un nuevo producto nativo de IA: OttoBox, el asistente de creación de video. Este importante producto, definido como el "compañero de creación de contenido de nueva generación" en la era de la IA, utiliza el modelo multimodal de extremo OmModel desarrollado internamente por Lianhui Technology como cerebro, y a través de una arquitectura funcional trinitaria de AI Drive, AI Finder y AI Agent, redefine un nuevo modelo de gestión y creación de contenido con IA.
